title: Light Lovely Brazilian Lardons Tagine
description: A hearty Brazilian dish featuring crispy lardons and tangy Branston pickle, cooked to perfection in a ceramic tagine, with a focus on ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients for a cozy meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large ceramic tagine, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the lardons to the tagine and cook until crispy, then set aside.
Add the diced tomatoes, black beans, salt, and pepper to the tagine and stir to combine.
Add the cooked brown rice to the tagine and stir to combine.
Add the chopped Branston pickle to the tagine and stir to combine.
Return the crispy lardons to the tagine and stir to combine.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh cilantro.
